entries.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset: an actual commemorative euro coin photograph for an online catalogue. Image 1 is the ONLY edit target. Images 2 and 3 are finish references only. Preserve EVERY original engraved line and shape, all inscriptions/accents/spacing, dates, mint marks, initials, and all twelve stars EXACTLY as in Image 1. Lock the exact circuit-board/brain outline, every branching trace, circular terminal and connection, the central open circle, the geometric text panel and small Slovak shield. Preserve all source Slovak wording, OECD, SLOVENSKO, 2020, accents and mint/designer marks exactly. No regularized or invented circuit paths.
